formal.statement: theorem general_variance_audit_certificate : (∀ (A : Type*) (B : Type*) [AddCommGroup A] [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] (p : B → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ i,0≤p i) (hp : ∑ i,p i=1) (increments : B → A), Function.Injective increments → ∀ target : A, (∑ h : Hash A B,(hashLaw p hp0 hp h).toReal*inDegree increments h target)=1 ∧ (∑ h : Hash A B,(hashLaw p hp0 hp h).toReal* (inDegree increments h target-1)^2)=1-∑ i : B,(p i)^2) ∧ (¬ ∀ increments : Fin 2 → ZMod 3, (∀ i,increments i≠0) → (∑ h : Hash (ZMod 3) (Fin 2),(uniformTwoLabelLaw h).toReal* (inDegree increments h 0-1)^2)=1-∑ _i : Fin 2,(1/2:ℝ)^2)
formal.scope: Every finite abelian group, every finite distinct increment table, all nonnegative normalized real label laws, actual product PMF and actual in-degree cardinality at every target. Exact mean1/variance1-sum(p_i²). Direct nonzero-only universal disproof by duplicate+1steps onZ3, variance0versus1/2. No collision-time/mixing asymptotic claim.
